title: Deferred image generation uses an in-memory queue
risk: Accepted work in Channel and TaskCompletionSource does not inherently survive restart. OperationId metadata is not a durable queue.
default_decision: Preserve the feature without describing it as durable. Reliability changes require an explicit admission/recovery specification.
required_before_affected_cutover: Restart between enqueue, provider response, and media commit; establish what was accepted and how an unknown external result is recognized.

title: Gateway idempotency across restarts and instances
risk: An in-memory semaphore and metadata-key lookup do not prove an atomic durable unique receipt or coverage of every path.
default_decision: Require CON-021; do not condemn the entire implementation without inspecting other guards.
required_before_affected_cutover: Find every writer and constraint; prove concurrent duplicate handling, changed-payload rejection, and replay after deletion/restart.

title: Workflow GetStatus applies status changes
risk: A query can mutate a projection; merely removing the side effect may remove existing writeback.
default_decision: Extract explicit reconciliation/refresh or a durable projector; preserve updates without an open page.
required_before_affected_cutover: Capture the current call graph and prove result delivery before and after moving it out of the read path.

title: Workflow admission versus a later projection failure
risk: An exception after launch may be mapped to start failure; complete impact depends on helpers and runtime behavior.
default_decision: Separate the launch receipt from projection failure. Do not relaunch because refresh failed.
required_before_affected_cutover: Inject failure after owner admission and around ApplyStatus; inspect the run store and verify a single execution identity.

title: Attributing outputs by node-set difference alone
risk: Existing-node snapshots and result projection may attribute another writer's concurrent change; additional lineage validation was not fully inspected.
default_decision: Prove outputs through an owner manifest and origin/run key, not time or set difference alone.
required_before_affected_cutover: Two concurrent runs, a human-created node, and late completion of an older run.

title: File upload before SQL commit and orphan cleanup
risk: SQL rollback cannot undo an external byte write; cleanup may delete content that has become shared.
default_decision: Explicit staging, finalization, reconciliation, reference eligibility, and evidence-based orphan cleanup.
required_before_affected_cutover: Storage success with DB failure, DB success with finalization failure, and repeated recovery.

title: Content versions and typed asset-edit actions
risk: Generic metadata editing is not file-content editing; a note must not act as fake file content.
default_decision: Preserve creation, upload, and preview. Content-version editing is an explicit follow-up feature, not a silent side effect.
required_before_affected_cutover: Characterize UI labels and actual byte revisions for supported edit paths.

title: Meeting/recording/transcript scaffolds are not capture or STT
risk: Typed scaffolding does not demonstrate a recording player, transcription, or provider I/O.
default_decision: Preserve native metadata; do not describe adding a transcript scaffold as a completed Transcribe operation.
required_before_affected_cutover: Inventory actual active actions/kinds, provider contracts, and existing evidence.

title: CRM technical-agent bridge and foreign writers
risk: The UI can correctly project agents while a synchronization implementation still writes foreign master data.
default_decision: Move mutation to the CRM owner rather than create a second technical-agent catalog.
required_before_affected_cutover: Inspect bridge callers, DB writes, commit-with-warning semantics, and preservation of local CRM governance.

title: Mixed ProjectPartyAssignment meanings
risk: Project role, task performer, and execution assignment may share current entities or payloads.
default_decision: Classify records semantically; preserve rates, intervals, and audit. No last-writer-wins or blind nullable-NodeId filtering.
required_before_affected_cutover: Reconciliation report, original rows, uniqueness invariants, and representative legacy fixtures.

title: Capacity reservations beyond capacity blocks
risk: A capacity block is not a confirmed reservation linked to a WorkAssignment.
default_decision: CRM/Staffing is the target owner; do not claim a new reservation implementation is already delivered.
required_before_affected_cutover: Establish current atomicity and supported capacity semantics before assignment changes.

title: Workload-aware AgentCostQuote
risk: Tariffs and existing cost strategies may not provide a unified quote with assumptions and revision.
default_decision: Agents/Providers computes quotes; the plan stores a historical baseline, not a competing price list.
required_before_affected_cutover: Map existing rates and cost evidence, units, unknown values, and expiry policy.

title: Human-in-the-loop and workflow/process backend parity
risk: Runtime approval support does not prove every workflow UI/backend recovery combination.
default_decision: Preserve existing approvals; complete HIL expansion is not automatically part of refactoring.
required_before_affected_cutover: Baseline matrix of supported backends, purposes, and approval continuations, including negative authorization proof.

title: Scheduler process-target support differs by surface
risk: General documentation and older maps do not establish a working process launcher or direct process-scheduling tool.
default_decision: Reverify each surface. The audited managed Scheduler tool is workflow-only; do not fake success or silently implement unsupported targets.
required_before_affected_cutover: Inspect current dispatcher, launcher, and registration; exercise each claimed target in the actual host.

title: Do connector commands have executable handlers?
risk: A manifest, renderer, or outbox slot does not prove an executable connector command.
default_decision: Registry/capabilities must expose unsupported status; do not modify every connector indiscriminately.
required_before_affected_cutover: Verify registry-to-handler-to-result paths and explicit failure without a handler.

title: Migrations versus runtime SQL initialization
risk: Earlier analysis identified several schema-creation paths; current composition may differ.
default_decision: Verify the full upgrade path before removal; one migration authority per table.
required_before_affected_cutover: Actual DB schema/history, current mapping, and empty/older-supported-database upgrade fixtures.

title: Product terminology inside MAF Core
risk: A clean ProjectReference graph can conceal product-specific tool names and policy inside a general layer.
default_decision: Move semantic policy into owner adapters while retaining neutral tooling mechanisms.
required_before_affected_cutover: Inspect descriptors, composer, policy, and actual attachment; preserve serialized tool names.

title: The stabilized Agents commit will change
risk: Reapplying this analysis over newer decoupling work can regress already-fixed behavior.
default_decision: Rebaseline the actual stabilized HEAD before the first slice; reuse completed seams.
required_before_affected_cutover: Record SHA, affected contract/serialization/model diff, and current test discovery.

title: New contexts must preserve hidden persistence behavior
risk: Concurrency stamping and model-cache keys can disappear; other interceptors were not exhaustively audited.
default_decision: Explicit model and token/filter/audit inventory; initial migration must preserve behavior.
required_before_affected_cutover: Concurrent edits, EF-model inventory, scope generation, old data, and migration snapshot.

title: Memory API dependency on UI
risk: Older wrapper/registry paths may reverse API-to-UI dependency direction.
default_decision: Use a Memory application contract, not a new facade over a Razor controller.
required_before_affected_cutover: Verify actual constructor/reference graph and production provider operations.

title: Plugin secret broker versus raw vault
risk: A broad vault resolver may bypass plugin purpose/grants; the type name alone does not prove this.
default_decision: Purpose-limited resolution without removing legitimate OAuth refresh.
required_before_affected_cutover: Cross-plugin denial, revoked grants, missing capabilities, and no secrets in logs/DTOs.

title: Collaboration membership and lifecycle
risk: The README is generic; detailed membership/message paths are inherited discovery anchors.
default_decision: Preserve a distinct Collaboration domain; do not merge it with Simple Chats or agent transcripts.
required_before_affected_cutover: Current thread, member, inbox, read, and write behavior before affected changes.

title: TestLab is not a universal node executor
risk: TestPlan/TestRun and a UI Test action do not prove a runner for every node kind.
default_decision: Typed supported runners and evidence target revisions; preserve project TestLab links.
required_before_affected_cutover: Characterize plans, cases, evidence, attachments, and available runner kinds.

title: Workspace contains control-plane and foreign settings
risk: Placement on the Settings page does not establish authority over provider prices, secrets, or database lifecycle.
default_decision: Workspace owns preferences and delegates each edit to its actual owner.
required_before_affected_cutover: Preserve profile activation, storage selection, provider references, and settings without full-host leakage.

title: Shared-provider live contract has not been executed
risk: Publishing/routing support does not prove network modes, revocation during a run, or every transport.
default_decision: Preserve exact published subset/provenance and explicit unsupported behavior.
required_before_affected_cutover: Local/shared parity for genuinely supported profiles/models/transports and revoked targets.

title: Snapshot fencing is an evidenced contract, not a new PASS
risk: Context extraction may drop coverage, fingerprint, generation, or authorization checks.
default_decision: Preserve explicit read sources and canonical mutations; do not claim complete snapshots without proof.
required_before_affected_cutover: Scope, profile, expiry, missing coverage, and stale callbacks across two circuits.

title: Database restore and data incarnation
risk: Reusing old event/key namespaces after restore can repeat an external side effect.
default_decision: Controlled restore, drain, and reconciliation with incarnation tied to the actual control plane.
required_before_affected_cutover: Restore with pending outbox/runs and verify identity, cursors, and lease guards.

title: Cost allocation and currencies
risk: Agent-to-workflow-to-process aggregation can count the same attempt repeatedly and mix units/currencies.
default_decision: Reference invocation evidence, explicit allocation/FX policy, and complete/partial/unpriced status.
required_before_affected_cutover: Same attempt in multiple projections, partial usage, explicit zero, and mixed-currency fixtures.

title: Simple Chats reporting hooks versus implicit context
risk: Historical report-to-Structure hook names do not invalidate the product's no-implicit-context/no-tools boundary.
default_decision: Do not remove a hook based on its name. Keep the product ordinary; preserve explicit export/report adapters respecting owners and scope.
required_before_affected_cutover: Find current callers/registrations and prove ordinary no-tools behavior plus the specific report operation.

title: Import/transfer and serialized-shape compatibility
risk: Moving types, enums, or assemblies can break persisted payloads, routes, alias IDs, and historical deletion defaults.
default_decision: Versioned adapters/manifests and identity remapping with provenance; never activate imported runs or secrets automatically.
required_before_affected_cutover: Representative legacy exports, stored operation payloads, and restart recovery.

title: Registry type/kind coverage is not a complete product audit
risk: The catalog records capabilities and 392 inherited anchors, not every method in every assembly.
default_decision: Discover affected surfaces before each slice; absence from this catalog does not authorize removing behavior.
required_before_affected_cutover: Reconcile actual UI, API, tool, worker, transfer, and persistence paths for each changed operation.

title: Application validation was not run during preparation
risk: Document structure and references cannot prove product behavior, migration safety, or runtime completeness.
default_decision: Keep application scenarios NOT_RUN until real evidence exists; package validation is a separate result.
required_before_affected_cutover: Execute the affected baseline and post-change proof plan in the product environment before cutover.

title: Cross-module automation beyond Structure was underspecified
risk: A Structure-only model can disable legitimate CRM/Resource/Simple Chats interactions or introduce a universal gateway.
default_decision: Use destination-owned query/command contracts and distinct runtime adapters; matrix is not blanket permission.
required_before_affected_cutover: Verify every affected existing caller plus the explicitly included new surface.

title: HR-to-Simple Chats definition adapter is missing
risk: Reimplementing Simple Chats under Agents would break ordinary product ownership.
default_decision: Reuse existing definition API through an external governed adapter; no transcript/tools dependency.
required_before_affected_cutover: Actual adapter registration, safe definition DTOs, concurrency, approval, receipt, and no-agent runtime proof.

title: Definition creation retry guarantee is not established
risk: Definition request shapes have no intent key; a post-hoc receipt can leave duplicate creation after a crash.
default_decision: Add/reuse an owner-atomic boundary in scoped work or expose truthful uncertainty and reconcile.
required_before_affected_cutover: Concurrent duplicate and crash-at-every-boundary tests; do not infer safety from a wrapper cache.

title: Interactive managed purpose is not background authority
risk: Broadening purposes or spoofing HR can escalate background jobs.
default_decision: Retain interactive identity gates; use separately approved executor/step delegation.
required_before_affected_cutover: Exercise allowed and denied purposes and revoked authority after restart/approval.

title: General direct Process tools are not established
risk: A process assistant/template or HTTP endpoint can be mistaken for an executable direct tool.
default_decision: Preserve actual bridges/API; implement new provider only in an explicit runtime/security scope.
required_before_affected_cutover: Inspect real provider registry, purpose, metadata, handler, and invocation evidence.

title: Source-to-provider and destination disclosure coverage unknown
risk: Safe owner query alone does not prevent confidential data being sent to disallowed LLMs or broader tasks.
default_decision: Require explicit data-use policy at affected integration boundaries without claiming full current coverage.
required_before_affected_cutover: Synthetic canary tests for raw/derived data, caches, artifacts, logs, and disclosure destinations.

title: Broader staffing and Resource automation is not universally attached
risk: Existing safe queries/affiliations do not prove every workforce/Resource mutation is a tool.
default_decision: Separate field/action grants; keep current working paths and add only requested bounded capabilities.
required_before_affected_cutover: Inventory actual owner methods and adapters, supported kinds, privacy, and persistence effects.

title: Foreign owner commit versus checkpoint gap
risk: Restart after foreign commit can duplicate contacts, definitions, or schedules.
default_decision: Persist effect identity before dispatch and reconcile owner receipt before replay.
required_before_affected_cutover: Crash after owner commit before workflow/process checkpoint with multi-instance delivery.

title: Complete source and runtime audit not performed in revision
risk: New pinned excerpts do not prove all historical sources or current runtime behaviors.
default_decision: Preserve original source pins and targeted-read limits; all application QA stays NOT_RUN.
required_before_affected_cutover: Rebaseline affected stabilized HEAD, complete helper/handler reads, and execute chosen proof gates.
